verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a hosted AI app-building product, so an official CLI is a fair axis to ask about, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party CLI. The community extractor scripts (comm-1) are a user-side workaround built because Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
